name: Add To Unsorted
distribution: Installed from the maintained iCloud Shortcut linked in Settings. The endpoint and token fields ship empty and are supplied by Shortcuts' import questions during installation, so the shared link carries no secret.
notes: requestId is optional. An active bookmark is unique per normalized URL, so a repeated share returns already_saved without a client-generated key.
The body is validated strictly: any field other than url and the optional requestId is rejected with 400 invalid_capture.
Success is read from the response body's result field, never from the request completing.
failureMessage: Failed to save to Later Gator
